items.title: *** EDPS Press Release ***
items.description: *** EDPS Press Release *** In a new Opinion, the EDPS supports the European Commission’s proposal for the EU KIDS Act (EU Keeping Internet Digital Spaces Accountable and Trustworthy): protecting children online and preventing regulatory fragmentation in the EU. The EDPS calls for safety by design for all users. The proposal would introduce age limits, requirements on safety by design and age assurance for online services accessible to minors, such as social networks, video-sharing platforms, online games and AI chatbots. The European Parliament and the Council should carefully consider which features require age assurance, and where safety by design for all users would also be effective. The Opinion's recommendations include: ✅ age assurance and parental verification obligations should only enter into application when privacy-preserving solutions are effectively available across the EU; ✅ algorithmic age estimation and other intrusive practices should be expressly excluded; ✅ the GDPR should be amended so that a single age of consent applies to all information society services in the EU.
